title: Wolny 2024 thoracic CL elongation at transition points I and II

quantity.name: elongation at transition points I and II
quantity.definition: elongation at start (I) and end (II) of linear region

source.authors: Wolny R, Wiczenbach T, Andrzejewska AJ, Spodnik JH
source.sample: 4 thoracic spines (body donors); 17 ALL, 19 PLL, 31 CL, 17 LF, 16 ISL+SSL bone-ligament-bone samples; human thoracic ligaments Th1-Th12, BLB samples

protocol.summary: Bone-ligament-bone samples (frozen -20 C, thawed in saline), bones reinforced and potted in PMMA cups; preload 5 N at 0.5 /s, 60 s relaxation; preconditioning 60 cycles at 10% strain, 1 Hz, 60 s rest; tension at constant strain rate 0.5 /s to rupture; environmental chamber 36.6 C, >=95% humidity. Failure = point where further elongation gives no force increase. Transition points I/II = start/end of linear region (<1% deviation between polynomial fit and linear approximation).
how_to_simulate: Model the thoracic ligament as a bone-ligament-bone unit with the measured initial length/width (Table 1)
Apply 5 N preload, then tension at strain rate 0.5 /s to failure
Report force-elongation (or first Piola-Kirchhoff stress = F/A0 vs stretch) at transition points I, II and failure

extraction.check_notes: Table values from text layer of publisher PDF (digital, clean); cross-checked row/column alignment manually.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
